literal: Five perception even when attained, benefit is indeed not, truth perception to those who lack.
translation: Even if they have mastered the perception of all five senses, there is absolutely no benefit for those who lack the perception of the ultimate truth.
modern: ஐம்புலன்களின் அறிவை முழுமையாகப் பெற்றிருந்த போதிலும், மெய்யறிவு இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு அதனால் எந்தப் பயனும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet contrasts sensory perception with the realization of ultimate truth. 'ஐயுணர்வு' refers to the knowledge gained through the five physical senses. Even if a person achieves complete mastery over these senses, it is of no real benefit ('பயமின்றே') if they lack 'மெய்யுணர்வு', which is the direct perception of reality. True wisdom lies beyond mere sensory experience, in understanding the fundamental truth of existence.
